records.source_title: 03-12-2026 11:29:44 Request for information about the Legion Pro 27q-10 OLED on the OLED Care system byMiysis56inDisplays, Options and Accessories Hello, I recently bought a Lenovo Legion Pro 27q10 monitor and it does not indicate the automaticfeatures of the monitor regarding screen protections.
records.author: Lorenzo_Lenovo
records.text:
Hello Miysis56,
Welcome to Lenovo Community
I understand that you are looking for the information about the
Legion Pro 27q-10
OLED Care system and screen protections.
About OLED Care and automatic protections:
Lenovo OLED monitors generally include several protections under the OSD “OLED Care” (names may vary): pixel/Panel Cleaning, Screen Move (pixel shift), Logo Luminance Adjustment, and Screen Saver.
Short “Pixel Cleaning” routines usually run automatically when the monitor enters standby or is powered off after use, while a longer compensation cycle can be started manually from the OSD. Exact trigger conditions (timers/durations) can vary by firmware and model.
You can always run the routine manually from the OSD if you prefer not to wait for the automatic cycle.
As for this model, it seems that it is manually configured via the OSD. See page 2-9 of the
monitor user guide
.
Hope this helps.
Best regards,
Lorenzo_Lenovo
